instruction: Candid documentary photograph, medium close-up at eye-level with a shallow depth of field. On a warm outdoor patio, the woman in the grey long-sleeve shirt (R1) on the left smiles happily directly at the camera. She is hugging the young woman in the floral dress (R2), who is on the right in profile, leaning affectionately into the woman (R1). The woman (R1) has her right hand resting on the young woman's (R2) shoulder. The scene is illuminated by soft, warm natural daylight, creating a joyful and loving atmosphere.

R1 is the embracing person while R2 is the person leaning into the embrace
